QuestInfo.name: Primrose
QuestInfo.1: The primrose fruit has disappeared without a trace, and the last few minutes of your memory are a bit fuzzy. You didn't eat it... Did you?\r\nYou'd better head back to #r#m307000110:##k and learn more about evening primrose. What if it's poisonous?!
QuestInfo.0: As you get a closer look at the moonlit evening primrose, you notice it's grown a small fruit on it! The scent of it is enough to tempt you to eat it...
QuestInfo.2: You learned the sad origins of evening primrose, but Eight barged into the potion lab and interrupted your research.

0.msg: Go back to #r#m307000110:##k and learn more about the primrose fruit.
